metaTitle: BMW Engine Supply & Fit | BMW Garage
metaDescription: Professional BMW engine supply and fit service. We source the correct engine for your BMW and install it in our Essex workshop. VIN-matching, full testing and warranty included.
lede: A bundled service where we handle everything from engine sourcing to final installation and testing. You don't need to find a used engine, verify its condition, or arrange delivery — we manage the entire process in one straightforward package.

sections.heading: What BMW Engine Supply & Fit Involves

blocks.html: A bundled service where we handle everything from engine sourcing to final installation and testing. You don't need to find a used engine, verify its condition, or arrange delivery — we manage the entire process in one straightforward package.

items: **VIN-based engine matching:** We identify the correct engine specification for your BMW using the registration and VIN, referencing BMW parts data to confirm engine type, size, and official code.
**Engine sourcing from established suppliers:** We procure a quality replacement unit — rebuilt, remanufactured, or a carefully inspected used engine with verifiable history.

**Pre-installation preparation:** Before fitting, we replace service items such as gaskets, seals, timing components, and the water pump on the replacement engine, ensuring it is ready for long-term service.
**Removal of your existing engine:** We carefully remove the failed unit, following BMW-specific procedures to disconnect all systems without damaging surrounding components.
**Installation and full testing:** The replacement engine is fitted, all systems reconnected, fluids filled, and the vehicle undergoes a comprehensive road test and diagnostic check before handover.

sections.heading: BMW Engine Supply & Fit — Starting Prices

blocks.html: Our supply-and-fit service includes a replacement engine sourced to your exact BMW specification, fitted in our Essex workshop, with a 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty. We never supply an engine without fitting it.

Prices vary by engine type, availability, and condition of the sourced unit. We quote after inspecting your vehicle and confirming the exact engine specification required — contact us for a precise estimate.

sections.heading: BMW Models and Engines We Supply and Fit

blocks.html: We supply and fit replacement engines for most BMW models and engine families. The service is tailored to your vehicle's exact specification — we never assume compatibility.

steps.title: VIN and registration check
steps.body: We use your BMW's VIN and registration to confirm the exact engine code, size, and specification required. This ensures compatibility from the start.

steps.title: Engine sourcing
steps.body: We identify a suitable replacement unit from our established supplier network — rebuilt, remanufactured, or carefully inspected used with verifiable history.

steps.title: Inspection and preparation
steps.body: The replacement engine is checked, and service items (gaskets, seals, timing components, water pump) are renewed as needed before fitment.

steps.title: Removal of existing engine
steps.body: Your original engine is carefully removed, with all connections documented to ensure a smooth refit of the replacement.

steps.title: Installation and refit
steps.body: The replacement engine is fitted, all systems reconnected, fluids filled, and a full operational test is carried out on-site.

steps.title: Road test and handover
steps.body: A road test confirms everything works properly before we hand the vehicle back to you, with a 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty.

sections.heading: Why choose BMW Garage for engine supply and fit

items: **VIN-accurate matching:** We don't guess — we use BMW-specific parts lookup tools to confirm the exact engine for your vehicle.
**No supply-only transactions:** We only supply engines we fit ourselves. Every unit is installed, tested, and warranted in-house.
**12-month unlimited-mileage warranty:** Included on every supply-and-fit job, covering parts and labour.
**Established workshop since 2009:** Based in Billericay, Essex, with BMW-specific experience and equipment.
**Full testing before handover:** Every replacement engine is road-tested and checked for proper operation before you collect.

sections.heading: How a BMW supply-and-fit service works with us

steps.title: Call or enquire online
steps.body: Tell us your BMW model, registration, and the issue — we'll schedule an initial assessment.

steps.title: VIN check and quote
steps.body: We confirm the correct engine specification and provide a fixed-price supply-and-fit quote.

steps.title: Engine sourced and fitted
steps.body: We procure the replacement unit, prepare it, remove your old engine, and install the new one.

steps.title: Tested and handed over
steps.body: Full testing and road check before collection, with warranty documentation provided.

items.q: What's included in the supply-and-fit price?
items.a: The price includes sourcing the correct engine, preparing it (replacing service items), removing your old engine, fitting the replacement, filling fluids, and full testing. A 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty is also included.

items.q: How do you know which engine is right for my BMW?
items.a: We use your vehicle's VIN and registration number to check BMW parts data, confirming the exact engine type, size, and official code. This eliminates compatibility risk.

items.q: Do you supply engines without fitting them?
items.a: No. We only supply engines that we fit ourselves. This ensures the unit is correctly installed, tested, and warranted as a complete service.

items.q: How long does a supply-and-fit job take?
items.a: Typical turnaround is 3-5 working days once the correct engine is sourced, depending on availability. We'll give you a clearer timeline when we quote.

items.q: What warranty do you offer on a supplied and fitted engine?
items.a: All our supply-and-fit jobs include a 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty covering parts and labour. Warranty terms are provided in writing.
